label: Article 3
title: The Third Commandment
path: Chapter One: You Shall Love the Lord Your God with All Your Heart, and with All Your Soul, and with All Your Mind

r: Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy. Six days you shall labor, and do all your work; but the seventh day is a sabbath to the Lord your God; in it you shall not do any work.
The sabbath was made for man, not man for the sabbath; so the Son of Man is lord even of the sabbath.
